title: The road by night
His lordship's road after dark
Night on the {other} road
summary: Things walk the road to {other} after dark, {distance} {direction} of {settlement}. Ride it by night and clear it.
His lordship's road is his by day; make it his by night. Clear the {other} road after dark.
Ride the road to {other} at night and put down what walks there.
offer: The carters say the {other} road is cursed after dark. It is not cursed; it is unpatrolled. Patrol it, {distance} {direction}.
Ride out tonight, along the road to {other}. Whatever walks there should not be walking.
A night on the road, in his lordship's name. Clear it of the dead.
progress: Is the road quiet at night?
Anything on the road last night?
complete: Quiet as a chapel. Well done.
The road is ours by night too. Thank you.
Good. The carters will travel late again.
